items.title: GTA VI Official News, Rumors, Leaks and Opinions
items.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI Official News, Rumors, Leaks and Opinions from our experienced team of writers.

items.title: Rockstar Games Reveals GTA VI Launch Trailer
items.summary: After a busy few weeks in Miami with GTA VI's marketing increasing on a daily basis, Rockstar Games finally unveiled the game's latest trailer, 5 weeks out from launch.

items.title: GTA 6 PlayStation Worldwide Release Countdown
items.summary: Official PlayStation Store listings reveal the exact GTA 6 launch times across 63 countries and regions, beginning in New Zealand and progressing through 15 release windows across 19 hours.

items.title: Exclusive: GTA 6 Beer Labels for Pißwasser, Patriot and "No Mames Vice City" Discovered in Official US Database
items.summary: Three beer labels that may be tied to GTA VI showed up in a US federal alcohol registry, all filed by a Florida brewery.

items.title: GTA 6 launch day is officially one month away
items.summary: With a month to go, pre-orders are open, pre-loading starts on November 12, and the Standard and Ultimate editions sit at $79.99 and $99.99.

items.title: GTA VI Merch Scalpers Are Charging Up To 2,735% More Than The Rockstar Store
items.summary: Resellers list official GTA VI merch on eBay far above retail, while some of the same items are still sold by Rockstar at the normal price.

items.title: GTA 6 locks in Nov. 19 release date after delays
items.summary: The November 19 launch is confirmed, with digital pre-downloads opening a week earlier on November 12.

items.title: Watch the Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer
items.summary: Rockstar released the launch trailer about a month before the game arrives on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

items.title: 'GTA 6' preorders are live: Where to buy for PS5 and Xbox
items.summary: A round-up of retailers taking pre-orders for the $80 Standard and $100 Ultimate editions ahead of the November 19 launch.

items.title: GTA 6 Gameplay Leaks Are Back with Potentially Big Spoilers
items.summary: A leaker posted around 25 minutes of footage said to come from a development build. Rockstar has not confirmed it.

items.title: Everything We Know About GTA 6 So Far
items.summary: A video roundup of what is known so far: the map, Jason and Lucia, story, money and robberies, wanted levels, combat and driving.

items.title: GTA VI "An Extended Look" Screencaps
items.summary: A gallery of more than 400 frames captured from Rockstar's An Extended Look video.
